doc.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe. Utica, New York, November 6, 2010 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Closing remarks
summary: Thanks, good wishes for the klezmer show with Krakauer, and plans to return to Hamilton next fall.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I appreciate your time today. It’s been very enjoyable.
Very enjoyable for me. Good questions. Challenging questions.
And good luck with the Klezmer tonight and the whole thing.
I’m sure it’ll be great. He’s always great. One thing about Dave, he puts on a great show. Sorry you won’t be there but it’s okay.
Well we are expecting you at Hamilton again next fall.
Which is lovely. Thank you for asking me. Yeah.
